title: Norwegian Lamb Tagine
description: A delicious and flavorful lamb tagine dish inspired by Norwegian cuisine, made with tender lamb and a hint of zesty spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the tagine spice blend, lemon juice, and chicken broth.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook until the lamb is tender, about 2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
